title: 65VI9 Appointed as Aide-de-Camp of the Military Police School
author: MPS HICOM
excerpt: After around five months in the Middle Command, 65VI9 has been appointed by HICOM as the new Aide-de-Camp of MPS.

body.text: The High Command of the Military Police School is pleased to announce the appointment of 65VI9 as the new Aide-de-Camp of MPS. The announcement was made by the Vice Chairman of the Military Police School, X_AgsFang, on behalf of HICOM.

65VI9 has been part of the school for a while, and HICOM pointed to his consistent activity and dedication as the reason for the choice. In the words of the announcement, HICOM believes he is the right fit for the position.

As Aide-de-Camp, 65VI9 is expected to assist and support HICOM so that the school keeps running smoothly and successfully. The Vice Chairman also noted that the position could place him as a possible next in line for HICOM if he performs well, while making clear that nothing is guaranteed.
HICOM expects him to continue the same activity and dedication he has shown so far towards MPS.
65VI9 served for around five months as part of the Middle Command before this promotion. Responding to the news, he shared the following:

I have been appointed as Aide-de-Camp, and it is truly an honor for me after serving for around 5 months as part of the Middle Command at the Military Police School. I promise to remain active, work hard, and give my very best in this new responsibility.
All members of MPS are invited to congratulate 65VI9 in the announcement channel on the MPS Discord server. Congratulations on the appointment, and good luck in the new role.
